name: ghostty-nag
description: Keeps the Ghostty Dock icon bouncing until you refocus the terminal, so you stop missing that Claude is done or waiting on you.

interval_seconds.title: Seconds between bells
interval_seconds.description: How often to re-send BEL while Ghostty is unfocused. Ghostty bounces the Dock once per bell.

max_seconds.title: Give up after (seconds)
max_seconds.description: Stop nagging once this much time has passed, even if you never come back.

bundle_id.title: Terminal bundle ID
bundle_id.description: macOS bundle identifier used for the focus check. Change this only if you run a Ghostty fork or nightly.
